facts: The paper presents a novel representation for three-dimensional objects.
The novel representation uses affine-invariant image patches.
The novel representation uses spatial relationships of affine-invariant image patches.
Multi-view constraints are associated with groups of patches.
Multi-view constraints associated with groups of patches are combined with a normalized representation of appearance.
The combination of multi-view constraints and a normalized representation guides matching.
The combination of multi-view constraints and a normalized representation guides reconstruction.
The proposed approach allows the acquisition of true three-dimensional affine models from multiple images.
The proposed approach allows the acquisition of Euclidean models from multiple images.
The proposed approach allows recognition of true three-dimensional affine and Euclidean models in a single photograph.
The single photograph for recognition can be taken from an arbitrary viewpoint.
The proposed approach does not require a separate segmentation stage.
The proposed approach is applicable to cluttered scenes.
entities: acquisition of true three-dimensional affine and Euclidean models
